title: In the kitchen
description: Name the things in a kitchen, and say where each one is.

explanation.summary: A kitchen is a room full of nouns, and in Spanish the article tells you which one is which. El and la are not decoration: el horno and la horno are not the same object.

sections.heading: The nouns and their articles
sections.body: Most of these words end in -o or -a, and the ending usually tells you the gender. El tenedor is masculine and la cuchara is feminine. The exception is la sartén, which ends in -a but is masculine in meaning and keeps el: la sartén is wrong, it is el sartén. Learn the gender with the word, because the ending is only a guide.

sections.heading: Saying where it is
sections.body: You already know how to say where something is: the verb estar, then the place. The place is often a room with en before it, or inside something with dentro. En la cocina means in the kitchen, and el horno está en la cocina means the oven is in the kitchen.

examples.es: el horno está en la cocina
examples.en: the oven is in the kitchen

examples.es: la olla está dentro del horno
examples.en: the pot is inside the oven

examples.es: la taza está encima de la mesa
examples.en: the cup is on top of the table

exercises.note: Most kitchen words are ordinary nouns, so the article does the work of telling them apart.
